text:
kelsey: quick thought 00ms - lightweight prefer/require/avoid for hosting routing. header example: Prefer-Hosting: dedicated;strict=false

mira: short +1. prefer should be best-effort, require must be fail-fast.

sam: billing question 00ms - if prefer->dedicated but resolves to hosted we bill by resolved. need logs for reconciliation.

kelsey: agree on billing-by-resolved and an audit log entry with requested vs resolved. also return X-Hosting-Resolved header so clients can reconcile.

ops-bot: note: emit metrics hosting.requested and hosting.resolved. tie to traces.

mira: edge-case: per-request vs manifest-level preference. support both; manifest-level wins if conflict. document precedence.

sam: tokens could give guarantees but add auth work. suggest header-only rollout first, token behind feature-flag.

kelsey: rollout plan: 1) header-only + metrics/logs 2) X-Hosting-Resolved + standard error for require (HTTP 424) 3) optional hosting_grant token later. I'll write RFC. ping @mira @sam for review. :thumbsup:
